text.en:
The Administrative Code is hereby amended by striking from the list of Acts thereby repealed in
their entirety, Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and ninety-seven.

Sections three and four of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and ninety-seven are hereby declared
again in force.

Whoever in a solemn affirmation made in any of the cases covered by section three of Act
Numbered Sixteen hundred and ninety-seven makes a false statement shall incur the penalties prescribed by
said section three.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 17, 1917.
